title: Codominance and multiple alleles: ABO blood groups
caption: Iᴬ and Iᴮ are codominant, and both are dominant to Iᴼ. A group A parent (IᴬIᴼ) and a group B parent (IᴮIᴼ) can have a child of any of the four groups, each with probability one quarter.
alt: A Punnett square of a group A parent and a group B parent, both heterozygous: one group AB, one group A, one group B and one group O child.
description: Parent 1 is IᴬIᴼ, group A; parent 2 is IᴮIᴼ, group B.
Gametes: Iᴬ or Iᴼ from one parent, Iᴮ or Iᴼ from the other.
Each blood group has probability 1 in 4.
